**Management Summary – Project LV €312,249**

The tender contains critical gaps that jeopardize cost certainty and risk allocation. High‑impact issues (total €19,891) include missing technical specifications for site facilities, undefined reinforcement for the floor slab, absent formwork for the foundation slab, and vague norm references for trench backfill. Contractual clauses shift all ground‑risk and price‑escalation exposure to the contractor, with no escalation or claim provisions, creating potential disputes. Medium‑level deficiencies (≈ €13,000) involve ambiguous terms (“Lasergefälle”, “ca. 30 cm”) and insufficient execution instructions for utility trenches. Immediate actions: (1) request detailed specifications and reinforcement drawings; (2) clarify applicable standards (DIN 4220, VOB/C ATV 311); (3) renegotiate risk clauses to include price‑adjustment and claim mechanisms; (4) amend ambiguous language to measurable criteria. Addressing these items will reduce claim risk and improve estimate reliability.
